description: This file is a PHP class defining the CustomerApproval model for the OpenCart admin system. It manages customer approval records, including CRUD operations, approval/denial of customers and affiliates, and filtering capabilities.

classes.name: CustomerApproval
classes.description: Represents the customer approval operations within the OpenCart admin system, including CRUD, approval, and denial of customer and affiliate approvals.

methods.name: deleteApprovalsByCustomerId
methods.description: Deletes all approval records for a specific customer ID from the database.

methods.name: getCustomerApprovals
methods.description: Retrieves a list of customer approval records based on provided filter criteria.

methods.name: getCustomerApproval
methods.description: Fetches a specific customer approval record by its ID.

methods.name: getTotalCustomerApprovals
methods.description: Counts total customer approval records matching filter criteria.

methods.name: approveCustomer
methods.description: Marks a customer as approved by updating their status and removing approval request.

methods.name: denyCustomer
methods.description: Removes a customer's approval request, effectively denying approval.

methods.name: approveAffiliate
methods.description: Approves an affiliate by updating their status and removing approval request.

methods.name: denyAffiliate
methods.description: Removes an affiliate's approval request, effectively denying approval.
